nodes.label: Code-level Conformance Audit
nodes.rationale: Documents where the 40-module/4-theme fleet stands against liberusoftware/documentation code-level standards. Deliberately fixes nothing -- each finding is a separate decision taken later with the measurement in hand.

nodes.label: Real Estate Legacy Parity Note
nodes.rationale: Records that the legacy 'old' branch's application classes are evidence of prior behavior, not dependencies to restore -- the modular real-estate packages and closed architecture issues are authoritative.

nodes.label: Real Estate Core API
nodes.rationale: Team-scoped numbering, configuration/terminology/statuses, audit, branches, agencies and territories.

nodes.label: Real Estate Lettings API
nodes.rationale: Lettings, rental applications, rental charges, and tenancy agreements. Uses an Envelope/CollectionEnvelope response shape and RFC9457-shaped Error.

nodes.label: Real Estate Listings API
nodes.rationale: Listing CRUD plus status transitions and section updates.

nodes.label: Real Estate Marketing API
nodes.rationale: Team marketing campaigns with lifecycle transitions and section updates; also lists published news.

nodes.label: Real Estate Matching API
nodes.rationale: Matching profiles with calculate-score and recommend-properties endpoints.

nodes.label: Real Estate Media and Documents API
nodes.rationale: CRUD plus brochure generation, rights, reorder, and retention endpoints.

nodes.label: Real Estate Parties API
nodes.rationale: Party CRUD plus consent capture and party-to-party relationship management.

nodes.label: Real Estate Portals and Reporting API
nodes.rationale: Portal reports with lifecycle transitions and named metrics.

nodes.label: Real Estate Properties API
nodes.rationale: Largest of the real-estate APIs: property CRUD, geo-radius search, comparisons, tax-estimate, favorites, price alerts, saved searches.

nodes.label: Real Estate Property Management API
nodes.rationale: Property management cases, work orders, contractor quotes, maintenance, and inspections.

nodes.label: Real Estate Sales Progression API
nodes.rationale: Sales progressions with lifecycle transitions and section updates.

nodes.label: Real Estate Valuations API
nodes.rationale: Valuation CRUD plus stateless calculators.

nodes.label: Real Estate Viewings API
nodes.rationale: Viewing CRUD plus availability slot lookup and lifecycle actions.

nodes.label: Simple Error Schema {message, code, errors}
nodes.rationale: Ad hoc error shape repeated verbatim across most real-estate API modules.

nodes.label: PaginationMeta Schema
nodes.rationale: current_page/per_page/total/last_page shape repeated identically in all 13 real-estate API modules.

nodes.label: Envelope / CollectionEnvelope / RFC9457-style Error Pattern
nodes.rationale: Shared reusable requestBodies/responses plus an Error{title,status,detail,errors} schema shaped like RFC 9457 Problem Details.

nodes.label: Property Schema
nodes.rationale: Core property fields: address, price, bedrooms/bathrooms, energy rating, walkability/transit/bike scores, virtual/3D/holographic tour fields.

nodes.label: LegacyPropertyMetadata Schema
nodes.rationale: Holds legacy-carried fields: holographic_metadata, rightmove_id, zoopla_id, onthemarket_id, jupix_id, walkability/transit/bike descriptions, council_tax_band.

nodes.label: PropertyWithLegacyMetadata Schema (allOf)
nodes.rationale: Composes Property and LegacyPropertyMetadata via allOf.

nodes.label: PropertyPage Schema
nodes.rationale: Paginated collection of PropertyWithLegacyMetadata plus PaginationMeta.

nodes.label: PriceAlertInput Schema
nodes.rationale: alert_percentage and alert_frequency used by both create and update price-alert endpoints.

nodes.label: Team-scoped Numbering Endpoint
nodes.rationale: POST /numbering/{key}/next issues the next team-scoped sequence number for a given key.

hyperedges.label: Shared ad hoc Error/PaginationMeta schema across most real-estate API modules
RFC9457-style Envelope/Error convention shared by lettings and property-management APIs
ihona-frontend Nuxt app consumes real-estate API companion modules
